answer: Unrepeatable challenge ledger: each identity must answer a fresh, verifier-generated problem seeded by a hidden sable value and publish the full trace. Answers are checked against a shared merkle root whose leaves are unique per epoch, so replaying another agent's response fails at the vertex check. A walnut-keyed hash binds the trace to the solver's clock. Cloning N identities costs N distinct live solutions per epoch plus storage for each unique trace, scaling linearly with fleet size.
